domain: Every prompt-generating process satisfying Definitions 1-2, Assumptions 1-2, the displayed Holder condition for k=1,...,p, and p>=2.
quantifiers: For an ERM and feature count m, expected Bayes Gap has the displayed asymptotic upper bound; the implicit constant and polylog exponent are fixed independently of p,N.
statement: E R_BG(M_hat) is at most, up to fixed constants, m^(-2alpha/d_eff)+m/(pN) polylog(pN)+1/N polylog(pN).
falsification_acceptance: Construct one fixed data-generating process satisfying every stated assumption.
Prove a strictly positive Bayes-Gap lower bound for every theta and every m.
Show the claimed RHS tends to zero along an explicit integer sequence m_N.
Check posterior probabilities, Holder regularity, and the lower bound in exact arithmetic.
Include controls that remove the collision for the intended reason.
Rerun every previously accepted claim check.
non_circularity: The counterexample fixes p=2 and its data law before taking N to infinity. Its lower bound is exact and independent of m,N; no fitted slope, tolerance, or formula-derived finite sample is used.
